v1.2.2b (15 May 2022) |feed_title = Update v1.2.2 |previous_update = [[v1.2.1]] |next_update = [[v1.2.3]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.2.2''' is the thirty-sixth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 13th of May 2022. It added golden perks and multiple fixes. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.2.2 update (released 13 May 2022) and two minor updates, the v1.2.2a (released 14 May 2022) and v1.2.2b (released 15 May 2022). ==Additions== *Golden Perks **[[Golden Minigunner]] **[[Golden Crook Boss]] **[[Golden Pyromancer]] **[[Golden Scout]] **[[Golden Cowboy]] **[[Golden Soldier]] ==Removals== *[[Burst Buff]] *[[Cash Shot Buff]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *All {{Color|Golden}} skins no longer provide buffs. *[[Soldier]]'s Level 4 upgrade cost increased from {{Money|4,000}} to {{Money|5,000}}. *[[Shield Health]] now decreases base health. *Leaderboards now work properly. *Fixed unit collision damage not increasing the Total Damage counter. *Fixed Total Spent counter not accounting for placement and upgrade costs being increased or decreased by buffs or debuffs, such as the the [[DJ Booth]]'s discount buff. *Fixed volume, dialog and camera shake settings. *Fixed volume sliders doubling themselves in settings. *Fixed being able to collide with the [[War Machine Sentry]]'s missiles. *Fixed being able to collide with the [[Engineer]]. *Fixed [[Shield Health]] causing targeting inaccuracies. *Fixed players not descending in [[MEGA Servers|MEGA elevators]]. *Fixed [[Elevators|elevator]] countdown playing after leaving the [[Elevators|elevator]]. :In '''v1.2.2a''': *Fixed not being able to obtain the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Commander]] skin. :In '''v1.2.2b''': *Fixed triumph leaderboards showing total triumphs instead of monthly triumphs. *Fixed not getting {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Engineer]] after purchasing Rank 9 with robux. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Duck Hunt 2022 icon.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.2.2=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|2 = Update v1.2.2}} {{UpdateH1|📆 Last chance to order!}} {{UpdateDottedIcon|* INTERNAL PAIN *|Available until 5/22/2022|PlushieCommander.png}} {{UpdateWhiteText|Now's your last chance to pre-order the limited edition [[Commander Plush (Level 1)|Commander Plushie]]!
